core_idea: Heishou Pack - You Branch Adept Heathcliff is a Status Specialist — **Burn** stacker — damage and clash scale with Burn on target. Scaling conditions: Clash Power +1 per 10 Burn (max +2); Coin Power +1 per 6 (Burn + Rupture) (max +2). **Heishou Pack** — in Chain Battles, fill backup deployment slots with other Sinners so substitutes enter when a deployed unit **dies** or **Retreats**.
playstyle_guide:
- Chain Battles only — each Sinner equips **one identity**; **death** or **Retreat** Substitutes a backup Sinner in with a fresh rotation. Stagger does not.
- Another **Heishou Pack** identity on a backup **Sinner** is ideal — faction passives and **The Lord of Hongyuan** procs stack across the substitute queue.
- Skills check **6+ Burn** — favour those coins when stacked.
- Skills check **6+ Rupture** — favour those coins when stacked.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Clash Power +1 per 10 Burn (max +2).
- S3 carries Unbreakable Coin — commit it when the clash strongly favors you.

**S1 — Peck 'em** (BP 2, CP +3, 3 coins): rolls — low 2, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- **Clash Power** scales with **Burn** (+1 per 10, max +2) — build stacks first.

**S2 — Mutilating Talons** (BP 4, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- **Clash Power** scales with **Burn** (+1 per 10, max +2) — build stacks first.
- executes weakened targets — reuses coin against enemies below 50% HP
- Gain 3 Burn and +1 Burn Count; [Heads Hit] If this unit has Bloodflame — 血炎 —, or if this unit has less than 50% HP, Reuse this Coin (once per Skill)

**S3 — Bloodflame Massacre ['''血炎亂舞''']** (BP 4, CP +3, 4 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Slightly Low).
- Unfocused Volley ; Deal +1.5% damage for every Burn on self (max 30%) ; [Combat Start] If this unit has Bloodflame — 血炎 —, or if this unit has less than 50% HP, convert all Coins to Unbreakable Coins ; [Before Use] At 20 Battleblood Instinct, activate 'Rooster's Rampaging Blades Under the Ensanguined Heaven' instead ; [On Use] Gain 3 Bloodflame — 血炎 — ; [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Burn + Rupture) on the main target (max 2) ; [On Use] Clash Power +1 for every 20% missing HP on self (max 3) ; [Attack End] Gain +2 Burn Count
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Burn + Rupture)** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition
- Apply 2 Burn to target and self; [Heads Hit] At 50%+ HP, take Burn damage by Burn Potency on self

*↳ Alternate S3 — Rooster's Rampaging Blades Under the Ensanguined Heaven ['''血天下雞舞亂刀''']* (BP 5, CP +3): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average / High stacked).
  - Unbreakable Coin

Combat passive — **Gamefowl**: When activating Exalted Command, The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu gains the following effect as the Heishou Bolus Contamination — 黑獸丸染 — effect:.
  - On Hit with this unit's Base Attack Skill: Deal 5% of Gluttony damage dealt as Wrath damage.
  - Cannot be Staggered or fall below 1 HP due to Burn damage.

Combat passive — **Bloody Storm of Blades**: Combat Start: gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up for every 20% missing HP on self (max 3).
  - Gain Battleblood Instinct when meeting one of the following conditions: (10 per turn).
  - Gain 3 at Clash Start.

Defense skill — **Counter: More Grub for Us**: [Clashable Counter].
  - [On Use] Gain 3 Bloodflame — 血炎 — next turn.
  - [On Use] If target has 10+ (Burn + Rupture), Base Power +1.
  - [On Use] If this unit has Bloodflame — 血炎 —, Coin Power +1.
